title: Measures to Mitigate against Flooding Given Inclement Weather Due To Indian Ocean Dipole
what_it_is: Measures to Mitigate against Flooding Given Inclement Weather Due To Indian Ocean Dipole

sections.label: PUB drainage investment and flood-prone areas
sections.summary: PUB has invested almost $2 billion on drainage works in the last decade, reducing flood-prone areas from 3,200 hectares in the 1970s to 28 hectares today, with another $1.4 billion to be invested over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: PUB has invested almost $2 billion on drainage works in the last decade and reduced Singapore’s flood-prone areas from 3,200 hectares in the 1970s to 28 hectares today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Another $1.4 billion will be invested over the next five years on drainage improvement works.

sections.label: PUB rainfall forecasting enhancements
sections.summary: PUB will complete enhancements to its rainfall forecasting capability by the first quarter of 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: PUB will complete enhancements to its rainfall forecasting capability by first quarter of 2022.

sections.label: PUB pressing charges against contractor
sections.summary: PUB does not condone such illegal works and will be pressing charges against the contractor under the Sewerage and Drainage Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: PUB does not condone such illegal works and will be pressing charges against the contractor under the Sewerage and Drainage Act.

sections.label: Coordination, unauthorised alterations, enforcement review
sections.summary: For major roadworks there has been close coordination of work and preventive measures, but unauthorised alterations and drainage blockage occur, so enforcement and monitoring measures will be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: In most cases, for major roadworks, such as for MRT stations, there has been close coordination of the work that is progressing and also the preventive measures that are being taken.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But, from time to time, we do have such unauthorised alterations and also blockage in the drainage; sometimes, it is intentional or, sometimes, it is actually because of poor housekeeping.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, we do have to step up and look at how we can improve the enforcement and monitoring measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will review our measures from time to time to see if they are adequately preventive.
